exactSubmittedPrompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit.
Asset: fixed original-RGB CONTACT COVERAGE MASK for the exact primary-approved Tomori neutral-presence TIME-ONLY NIGHT mother. Only input is that complete clean 1536×1024 mother. Keep full original canvas, camera, every coordinate unchanged. Output an OPAQUE BLACK-AND-WHITE luminance mask, not new RGB artwork, not transparency.

WHITE selected coverage: BOTH ENTIRE original black loafers, every actual outer dark edge from shoe opening to complete toe/upper rim/sidewall/outsole/heel, plus the immediately touching original soft floor-contact shadow and local wood receiver. Shoe AND footprint form ONE CONTINUOUS SOLID WHITE selected shape per shoe, no tiny black moat, crack or contour between selected shoe and selected receiver. In particular fully include the near/front loafer's left-facing sloping upper contour near source x865..940,y825..880; no one-pixel excluded line along that dark edge. Selection must extend through that real shoe edge to the original adjacent floor contact, not erode shoe. Fill all shoe seams, toe highlights, stitching and interior dark detail white. Include short soft real receiver right up to and slightly OVERLAPPING every shoe edge; overlap is intentional and harmless under MAX with F. Gray only the EXTERNAL original soft contact edge, not inside either shoe.

Also WHITE only the small real linen cushion contact immediately under her skirt/blazer at the seated hip near source x1180,y584: a tight short irregular receiving-material patch, no long bench strip. All other pixels BLACK: whole hair, head, face, neck, torso, arms, notebook and pencil, lap/knees, calf socks ABOVE shoe openings, curtains, lamp, flowers, table, other furniture, empty linen, pillows, blanket, rug, distant floor and unrelated light/shadows. Do not select a broad lamp pool or invent detached ellipses. No new shoe shape, expansion of footwear itself, resize, recenter, crop, outline, checkerboard, color, text or label.

Purpose: source RGB will be taken once from this exact untouched mother beneath MAX(L(F),L(S)). S intentionally includes complete shoes overlapping F plus LOCAL original wood/cloth receiver. It is fixed original-position INCLUDED material, NOT independent movable shadow. Travel/slope/perspective=0. Keep EXACT 1536×1024 source geometry.
